name: PA-1
description: "A two way speaker system using a passive radiator system.PA-1 was manufactured by Pawel Acoustics.The low-frequency band features a hand-made, custom-made 13 cm cone woofer.A unique diaphragm made of synthetic foam sandwiched between several microns of aluminum foil and paper is used for the diaphragm of the unit to realize a light and hard diaphragm. In addition, a high-speed driver is realized by taking a long stroke and driving it with a powerful magnetic circuit in order to secure a low frequency range.The high-range is equipped with a 1.9 cm soft dome type tweeter, which is made by hand and custom-made like a woofer.It is equipped with KEF's elliptical passive radiator SP139 in order to increase the bass reproduction capability.This passive radiator covers most of the back of the enclosure and removes the back pressure on the woofer unit.The front baffle is tapered and a carefully designed network is used to achieve phase matching between the two units, and the front baffle is tapered to prevent standing waves from occurring in the enclosure.The enclosure had two finishes : Swiss cherry and satin black."

name: PRIMADONNA
description: "A floor-type speaker system with a new enclosure and network while using the unit used in REFERENCE.A 13 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm of this unit has a completely conical shape without a center cap, eliminating the distortion caused by the front chamber effect in the cone diaphragm.A 1.9 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The inclined front baffle reduces the phase difference and time difference between units, and the large arc front baffle prevents acoustic reflection at the baffle diffraction point.The enclosure had two finishes : a Swiss cherry finish and a Piano Black finish."

name: Specification
description: "This speaker system was developed based on the knowledge and technology obtained with the PA-1 and ignoring the cost and various constraints.PA-1 was manufactured by Pawel Acoustics.A 13 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm of this unit has a completely conical shape without a center cap, eliminating the distortion caused by the front chamber effect in the cone diaphragm.A 1.9 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.This tweeter has the same standard as the PA-1, but uses only carefully selected units one by one.It is equipped with KEF's elliptical passive radiator SP139 in order to increase the bass reproduction capability.This passive radiator covers most of the back of the enclosure and removes the back pressure on the woofer unit. In addition, Reference adjusts the tuning of the passive radiator to enhance low-frequency expression.LC-OFC wiring is used for internal wiring, and carefully selected network elements are also used.The front baffle is tapered and a carefully designed network is used to achieve phase matching between the two units, and the front baffle is tapered to prevent standing waves from occurring in the enclosure.In addition, the Reference is made of carefully selected materials uses dense wood to increase its rigidity.The enclosure had two finishes : a Swiss Cherry finish and a custom piano black finish.The Snoitrick SPEAKON connector is used for bi-wiring.2m dedicated cable with special connector is included."
